headline: Run Frontier-Scale AI Models on Consumer Hardware
lede: AirLLM breaks the VRAM barrier by dynamically loading model layers during inference. This approach makes behemoth models like Llama 3.1 405B accessible on modest workstations.

headline: Standardizing AI Agent Workflows for Security Research
lede: The reverse-skill framework enforces rigorous methodological discipline for AI agents engaged in penetration testing. It moves beyond speculative command generation toward verified, evidence-based security operations.

headline: High-Speed PDF Extraction Without Resource-Heavy OCR
lede: This Rust library prioritizes raw parsing efficiency, classifying and extracting structured text from PDFs in under 200 milliseconds. It replaces bloated cloud-dependent pipelines with a local, deterministic alternative.

headline: DeepSeek-Native Coding Agents Optimized for Terminal Loops
lede: Reasonix brings long-session context management directly to your command line. By focusing on prefix-cache stability, it minimizes API overhead for heavy development tasks.

headline: Progressive Pipelines for Persistent Agent Memory
lede: TencentDB Agent Memory replaces flat vector storage with a hierarchical structure that distills logs into readable personas. This ensures agents retain context across long-horizon projects without bloating the window.

headline: Master Artificial Intelligence with this Twelve-Week Curriculum
lede: Microsoft’s AI-For-Beginners repository provides a structured, lab-based roadmap from neural networks to reinforcement learning. Executable Jupyter Notebooks translate theoretical concepts into tangible, deployable code.

headline: A Practical Guide to Building Generative AI Applications
lede: This curriculum bridges the gap between AI concepts and production-ready implementation. Learners gain hands-on experience with prompt engineering and LLM lifecycles through modular build sessions.

headline: The Definitive Knowledge Base for Scalable System Design
lede: Master the complexities of distributed architecture, caching, and load balancing with this essential repository. It provides the frameworks required to navigate high-stakes technical interviews.

headline: Optimized Engines for DeepSeek and GLM Local Execution
lede: DwarfStar offers a specialized inference pipeline for power users running massive parameter models on local clusters. By streamlining memory utilization across hardware backends, it maximizes throughput for private instances.

headline: Forecasting Market Trends with Specialized Transformer Architectures
lede: Kronos treats financial market data as discrete tokens to bypass the high-noise issues of traditional time-series models. This framework provides quantitative researchers with a high-performance path for market analysis.
